measurement: process memory 30–40 seconds after readiness; new stack also waits for artifact preparation
aggregation: Median of three per-start medians; each start has snapshots at requested 30, 35 and 40 seconds; fresh project data and cached artifacts; warmups excluded.
units: MiB = 1,048,576 bytes; requested/actual offsets are milliseconds
rssAccounting: Exact owned workload processes plus the new stack Supervisor and descendants. Shared pages may be counted repeatedly. Native supervisor already belongs to the workload total; Docker host supervisor is added separately.
pssAccounting: Linux smaps_rollup apportions shared pages. macOS native PSS unavailable. macOS Docker workload PSS is available, but total PSS is unavailable because its host Supervisor runs on macOS.
overhead: Docker daemon, containerd, Linux meminfo and shared OrbStack host processes are context only, excluded from stack totals. They are not exclusively attributable to one stack.

linuxEnvironment.host: Apple M3, same physical host as macOS

macVmContext.basis: Whole shared OrbStack host processes, not attributable Docker-only overhead
